project.name: Ladybank
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Ladybank’s score is earned by the village-and-woodland visit itself, without borrowing Fife Zoo or neighbouring attractions. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. Fife Zoo, Africafe and other Birnie Field content are outside the strict Ladybank settlement/woodland audit and are not transferred. The Golf Inn is included only through the dedicated daytime Bunker Café offer, not full meals. No public toilet is invented.

touristAppeal.label: Notable Stop
touristAppeal.summary: Ladybank is a genuine short-break destination for its large woodland and 12.4 km circuit, supported by two coffee/light-lunch stops, picnic parking and excellent rail access.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Verified outdoor routes can suit responsible dog visits, with close control around livestock, roads, wildlife and historic fabric.

visitorHighlights.name: Ladybank Woodland
visitorHighlights.reason: Extensive publicly accessible woodland used for walking and cycling on a network of forest tracks close to the village.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Open access; follow current forestry notices.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Ladybank Woodland is scored from the visit experience, distinctiveness, presentation, journey worth, access reliability and evidence quality rather than designation alone.
